parameters.question: Compute posterior probability of disorder given positive test (prevalence 1/10,000, sensitivity 99%, specificity 98%) using Bayes' theorem. Posterior must match the reference within +/-0.0001 (expected ~0.00493). The output must also include the intermediate quantities: prior (0.0001), likelihood P(+|D)=0.99, and marginal P(+) (~0.020097).
